title: Reference
---

### Python API

| | |
|---|---|
| [inif.converters.evaleval](inif.converters.evaleval.qmd) | Convert every_eval_ever instance-level records into INIF documents. |
| [inif.converters.inspect_ai](inif.converters.inspect_ai.qmd) | Convert Inspect AI EvalLog objects and .eval files into INIF documents. |
| [inif.converters.text](inif.converters.text.qmd) | Build INIF documents from raw text strings or text files on disk. |
| [inif.flat](inif.flat.qmd) | Flat parallel-array view of an InifDocument for high-throughput scans. |
| [inif.indexed](inif.indexed.qmd) | Indexed archive format — incremental writes, header-only reads, random sample access. |
| [inif.io](inif.io.qmd) | Save and load INIF documents — JSON dispatch and dict conversion. |
| [inif.models](inif.models.qmd) | Core Pydantic models — InifDocument, Sample, Token, Sequence, and friends. |
| [inif.schema](inif.schema.qmd) | JSON Schema export and validation for INIF documents. |
| [inif.selectors](inif.selectors.qmd) | Pick token positions and sample subsets out of a document. |
| [inif.sequences](inif.sequences.qmd) | Find shared token runs across samples and replace them with sequence references. |
| [inif.tagging](inif.tagging.qmd) | Add named annotations to tokens via regex, predicate, or chat-template role matching. |
| [inif.viewer](inif.viewer.qmd) | Render an InifDocument as a self-contained interactive HTML page. |
